issues.message: 49 dimensions are illustrative test-only assumptions; drawings label them.

Compiled 13640 triangles; corrugation/bend chord error 0.173 mm.

issues.expected: a qualified strategy for the verified wall type
issues.message: No flashing strategy chosen: counterflashing attachment to the wall is unresolved.
Galvanic/chemical compatibility of the flashing and roof-sheet metals is unknown until both are sourced.
Required air transition is not made: air-control continuity from roof to wall is unresolved
Air/vapour-control placement, condensation and drying depend on climate (unknown); no hygrothermal calculation has been performed. Do not place a vapour barrier from a generic climate guess.
Corrugated metal roof sheet: no manufacturer product selected; the manufacturer's detail is required before specification.
Base / apron flashing: no manufacturer product selected; the manufacturer's detail is required before specification.
Counterflashing (wall attachment unresolved): no manufacturer product selected; the manufacturer's detail is required before specification.
The corrugated profile's minimum pitch and end/side lap rules are manufacturer-specific; 10.0° is unverified.
No evidence supports this assembly's junction strategy yet.
Unverified structural specification — qualified review required: fastener spacing, pull-out, uplift, load path, rafter bearing at the masonry and structural capacity. Geometry cannot clear these.
12 fasteners bridge the insulation; their thermal effect is not quantified.
Exposed timber protection (finish, moisture at the bearing, fire) is not assessed.
Wall type unknown: solid/bonded vs cavity is unresolved; two wythes do not establish a cavity. Alternatives stay conditional.
